title: Delete a Gmail thread with AI: permanent removal
h1: permanently delete one gmail conversation with ai
description: Remove a whole Gmail conversation permanently with AI. Read every reply before deciding; use trash instead if you might need the conversation back.
answer: **that old thread can take the signed attachment with it.** delete thread removes every message in a gmail conversation immediately and permanently. it skips trash, so there is no undo. use it only for mail you want gone for good. sending approval does not hold deletion; tell the bot to ask before it removes anything.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: permanent means every message in it.
what:
**read back to the first reply before saying goodbye.** a search may match the last message, while the signed file sits further back. have the bot show the subject, people and message count, then open the whole conversation.

for an ordinary inbox clear-out, use trash. permanent deletion is for the conversation you have decided must go.
uses: **a secret sent by mistake:** remove a thread containing a password or bank details after you decide it must go.
**the wrong file:** delete the named conversation after checking every reply.
**an obsolete conversation:** review it alone, instead of wiping a folder.

routine.message: every friday at 5, find gmail conversations labelled "to shred". show each subject, everyone in the conversation and its message count here. ask me before deleting anything. delete permanently only the conversations i choose. if i don't reply, delete nothing. leave every other conversation alone.
routine.needs: gmail read and write for this bot; keep the allowed actions narrow
routine.output:
2 conversations labelled to shred
- old lease scan: you and vesna, 4 messages
- deposit bank details: you and the letting agent, 2 messages

which conversation should go forever?

steps: **find it first.** connect gmail read only while the bot searches.
**read the whole thread.** ask for its subject, people and message count.
**allow deletion deliberately.** enable read and write with only the needed actions. say "ask me before deleting anything".
**try one proposal.** compare the people and message count with gmail. pause the friday review when you no longer need it.
watch: **choose trash while you still have the choice.** it is the route for mail you might need again. this action removes the entire conversation for good.
**keep deletion out of everyday sorting.** allow only the reads and deletion this job needs, rather than the full gmail action list.

faq.q: can i restore the thread from gmail trash?
faq.a: **no. there is no copy in trash.** this action deletes permanently. choose the separate trash action if recovery matters.

faq.q: does deleting a thread remove only my last reply?
faq.a: **it removes them all.** have the bot read the whole conversation, including older replies, before you decide.

steps: ask the bot to find one conversation without changing it
read its subject, people and message count
open it in gmail and inspect older replies

mistakes.mistake: using permanent deletion for a tidy inbox
mistakes.fix: choose trash when you might want the mail back.

tip.text: if you hesitate, keep deletion disabled.
